title: State Ballot Measures — Statewide Results, November 3, 2026 General Election (unofficial, as of November 10, 2026, 5:31 p.m.)

verified.claim: Results are unofficial until certified by December 11, 2026.
verified.quote: Unofficial Election Results Results will be certified by December 11, 2026.

verified.claim: Proposition 3 (keeps the higher state income tax rates on high incomes permanently) was ahead, 60.6% yes.
verified.quote: Yes | 3 | Provides Permanent Funding For Schools And Health Care By Extending Existing Tax On High Incomes. Initiative Constitutional Amendment. | 7,101,047 | 60.6% | 4,610,136 | 39.4%

verified.claim: Proposition 42 (bars new state taxes on personal property such as financial assets, and certain retroactive taxes) was narrowly ahead, 51.5% yes.
verified.quote: Yes | 42 | Prohibits New State Personal Property Taxes And Certain Retroactive State Taxes. Initiative Constitutional Amendment. | 6,024,692 | 51.5% | 5,673,727 | 48.5%

verified.claim: Proposition 40 (one-time tax on very large fortunes) was behind, 47.4% yes.
verified.quote: No | 40 | Imposes One-Time Tax On Certain Taxpayers. Initiative Constitutional Amendment And Statute. | 5,593,408 | 47.4% | 6,205,615 | 52.6%

verified.claim: Proposition 43 (would have made voter-initiated local special taxes harder to pass) was behind, 42.6% yes.
verified.quote: No | 43 | Limits Voters' Ability To Raise Revenues For Local Government Services. Legislative Constitutional Amendment. | 4,900,795 | 42.6% | 6,593,042 | 57.4%

verified.claim: The 14 measures on the November 2026 ballot were Propositions 1-5 and 37-45; none changes Proposition 13 or the Proposition 19 inheritance rules.
verified.quote: Proposition 1 Authorizes Bonds for Housing Affordability Programs. ... Proposition 5 Changes Recall Election Process for Statewide Officers. ... Proposition 37 Creates Loan Program for Middle-Income Buyers of Qualified New Homes. ... Proposition 45 Modifies Environmental Review for Certain Projects.

title: S.587 — Death Tax Repeal Act of 2025 (119th Congress); related bill H.R.1301

verified.claim: Bills to repeal the federal estate tax were introduced in February 2025 and have not moved beyond committee referral.
verified.quote: 02/13/2025 | Introduced in Senate ... Senate Finance | 02/13/2025 | Referred To ... H.R.1301 | Rep. Feenstra, Randy [R-IA-4] | Death Tax Repeal Act | Related bill | CRS | 02/13/2025 Referred to the House Committee on Ways and Means.

title: SB 974 (2025-2026), Chapter 665 — generational transfers: special needs trusts

verified.claim: A 2026 law amended the Proposition 19 statute (section 63.2) for special needs trusts; it was approved September 27, 2026.
verified.quote: Senate Bill No. 974 CHAPTER 665 An act to amend Section 63.2 of the Revenue and Taxation Code, relating to taxation. [ Approved by Governor September 27, 2026. Filed with Secretary of State September 27, 2026. ]
